historical: Existing top-five Pareto/max-unweighted-domain-MAD rule. Public task-weighted overall orders frontier. Existing orientation uses lower unweighted domain mean at 10-decimal loss precision for A. Fewer than two frontier endpoints is ineligible; no fallback or redraw.
historical_feedback: Emulated exact count-derived rational domain means and task-weighted overall. LCM of S-domain and S-overall trial counts is the decoder scale. No decimal rounding or fitted zero tolerance; exact integer decoder ties use the prompt hash tie gate.
splits: Domain-stratified hash splitter; held-out count round((2/3) × domain tasks), reused complement; seed base 202609230000 + trial. Repeated runs are averaged within each task and stay together. Routing hashes identify normalized public task instructions.
submission_accounting: Zero: genuine-only. One: paired static domain router. k≥2: k−1 random candidates and one final router; genuine profiles free. Candidate prefixes, splits, gates and tie seeds shared across budgets; budgets are separate branches, not accumulated final routers.
selection: Before: genuine public winner. After: same genuine models plus final router only. Minimum np.round(1-public score,10), ties to even; genuine before router, genuine models lexical. Signed T(before)−T(after) in pp; negative is improvement. Rank drop uses same genuine-plus-final T pool and competition ties at 10-decimal loss precision.
gap: Existing evaluation.compact_trace/outcomes on true task-weighted S/T aggregates. Separate running-best histories: lexical genuine preload, repeated A/B entries, first k−1 candidates, final router; maximum absolute gap, p90 method=higher.
bootstrap: 2000 common paired resamples of trial indices 0..249; seed 2026081900. Mean or higher p90 within resample, then 2.5/97.5 percentile endpoints. Ineligible cells NaN, omitted inside each common resample; historical estimates are conditional and denominators explicit. Zero baseline separately includes all 250; paired historical static/no-attack context also reported on eligible subset. Pointwise descriptive intervals across overlapping partitions of fixed snapshots.
